levels.surface: عبد الله بن عامر بن ربيعة

notes: The saying is Aisha's account, so she is the last link
«بمثل حديث سليمان بن بلال» names another transmitter for the same saying, with no line of transmission written: a single-link variant group
«حدثناه» is the compiler's «و حدثنا» (the same narration) and is not a second isnad
